01_vehicle metadata comparison: reward popup only

All candidates are 640x640 / Q40 / alpha60. Compare color, brightness, saturation, translucent shadows, fine lines, and transparent edges. The input PNGs contain no EXIF, XMP, comments, or ICC profile, so all three outputs are expected to be byte-identical.

Each candidate comes directly from its formal PNG, resized once with LANCZOS, lossless=false, quality=40, alpha_quality=60, method=6, and exact=true. Baseline preserves source metadata where present. strip_meta omits EXIF/XMP/comments. strip_meta_icc also omits ICC. This page deliberately contains only the 630x472px reward-popup equivalent, with centered images aligned to the bottom.
